examples.title: Tidewater · Fishing rules
examples.scope: Exact original fishing and economy modules with a small standalone host. Demonstrates tension, terminal outcomes, hold capacity, selling and isolated saves; not a recreation of the original 3D scene.
dependencies: Browser ES modules
No renderer or external network
Original FishTable and Gear data
examples.limitations: The pure core is unchanged. The example host runs fixed 60 Hz with seeded RNG and its own storage namespace. Fish encounters, 3D presentation, boat integration and all upgrades are outside this example. Original GameState.spend assumes a valid nonnegative amount; do not expose it to untrusted input. No claim of complete original-game parity.

examples.title: Cloudkeep · Flight and camera lab
examples.scope: Original Cloudkeep flight simulation, chase camera and input modules running unchanged in a small host with slow motion, camera helpers and an original-vs-direct follow comparison.

Original simulation.ts, flight-camera.ts, input.ts
Original GLB assets copied by build.mjs

examples.title: Cloudkeep · Model turntable
examples.scope: A standalone turntable for all 18 archived Cloudkeep GLB assets, with mesh, triangle, vertex, material and file-size statistics, wireframe and vertex-color toggles, and base/distant model comparisons.
dependencies: Three.js r186 WebGL 2, GLTFLoader and OrbitControls (bundled from the archive's node_modules)
Vite from cloudkeep/upstream/node_modules for building the TypeScript host
18 original GLB assets and their pinned provenance manifest, copied by build.mjs
examples.limitations: The viewer inspects archived Blender outputs; it does not run Blender, rebuild assets or demonstrate the full authoring pipeline. Assets are centered and scaled to fit, so original world sizes cannot be compared. Base/distant switching is available only for island, lighthouse, orchard and ruins. Geometry counts sum across mesh instances. WebGL 2 is required; browser behaviour is not certified by the provenance tests.

examples.title: Cloudkeep · Creature ecology

Browser checks cover this isolated fixture, not complete game parity. Saves use the original key on the separate port 8110 origin.

examples.title: Tidewater · FFT ocean and surface queries

Original custom WebGPU engine and WGSL compute/readback modules
Original procedural BoatModel, buoy geometry and hull settings
Plain browser ES modules; no build or external network
examples.limitations: New host camera, water grid and shading call the original surface query shader. Buoys follow query heights/normals directly; the boat uses original rigid-body buoyancy. Original query latency uses simulation time, not wall-clock GPU timing.
